description: This source file implements the functionality for adding a follower (follow) relationship between users in a social media-like application. It contains a command, validation logic, and a handler that processes the follow request, interacting with the database context to create follow connections and retrieve user profiles.

classes.name: Add
classes.description: Contains the command, validator, and handler for adding a follower in the system.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously processes the command to add a follower, interacts with the database to establish follow relationships, and retrieves updated profile information.
